title: Walking the Embedding Space: Datastore Extraction from Multimodal RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.01871v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks.   In this paper, we introduce $\immrag$, an adaptive and automatic data extraction attack procedure operating in a black box setting against \emph{image-returning} MRAG, a configuration in which the retrieved visual artifact is itself the response. Each query blends an attacker-held shadow image with an image already recovered from the system, and relevance-weighted resampling steers subsequent queries towards regions of the embedding space that still yield novel retrievals. translated_title: 漫步嵌入空间：针对多模态检索增强生成（RAG）的数据存储提取攻击
translated_abstract: 多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）已成为一种可靠且经济高效的技术，能够将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的生成能力锚定到相关且最新的外部知识上。尽管其具有减少幻觉行为等诸多优势，但同时也引入了新的攻击面，包括隐私信息泄露以及易受数据提取攻击的脆弱性。本文提出了IMMRAG，一种在黑盒设置下针对“图像返回型”MRAG（即检索到的视觉产物本身即为响应的配置）的自适应、自动化数据提取攻击方法。每个查询将攻击者持有的影子图像与已从系统中恢复的图像进行混合，并通过基于相关性加权的重采样引导后续查询走向嵌入空间中仍能产生新颖检索结果的区域。与现有的额外……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了IMMRAG，一种针对图像返回型多模态RAG系统的黑盒自适应数据提取攻击方法，通过将影子图像与已恢复图像混合并利用相关性加权重采样在嵌入空间中“漫游”，系统性地提取数据存储中尚未泄露的新颖图像。
en_tdlr: IMMRAG is an adaptive, automatic black-box data extraction attack against image-returning Multimodal RAG, which blends attacker-held shadow images with recovered images and uses relevance-weighted resampling to walk the embedding space and extract novel datastore entries.
